hint.text: To come up with music and write it down is called composing. A person who comes up with musical pieces and writes them down is called a composer.
hint.label: Did you know?

atoms.text: When you want to write down a piece of music that you’ve come up with, you need something to write and something to write on.

In order for someone to be able to read the music you’ve written, you need a system of writing music, similar to writing letters on lined paper or numbers on graph paper. In music, we write notes on a stave.

instruction.text: Which of these pictures shows a stave? Select the correct picture.

atoms.text: With particular elements, you can describe the melody and rhythm of a piece of music. In this exercise you will learn some of these important elements.
Very important elements in music notation are the stave, the clef, the time signature, and of course the notes themselves. All together they describe the piece of music.
Five lines, and the space in between them, form the basic structure of the stave. Other elements are placed on or in between the lines.
You write down the sounds in a piece of music using notes. The notes show the pitch and how long you should hold each sound for.

atoms.text: A piece of music is divided up into smaller parts using bar lines. These smaller parts are called bars. The time signature lets us know how long a bar is.
The time signature is located next to the clef.
